intent: Attach a proving test to the reviewed rule dispatch-incident-halt-is-never-downgraded, whose reviewing package is no longer in the repository.
observable_outcome: coverage lists dispatch-incident-halt-is-never-downgraded as proven, and get-record names the obligation that proves it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A dispatch halt declared as a P1 incident outranks a capacity pause on the same target: a later capacity pause replaces neither its source, its reason nor its declarer, and only an operator lifts it. A capacity pause lifts itself after two consecutive clear reconciler rounds.
